findings.description: A weekly City Hall agenda roundup: development-agreement changes for the Potrero Power Station project (the former PG&E plant site in Dogpatch), Transbay Under Ramp Park land and street changes, Open Space Fund borrowing, a PG&E-takeover EIR appeal, and a SoMa street-tree hearing. Several projects are named, but no event at a numbered street address.

extra.headline_is_about_this_building: no — a roundup headline naming no building
extra.headline_as_published: S.F. lawmakers tackle hunger, PG&E, and SoMa street trees, plus changes to major development plans this week

citation.label: The Voice of San Francisco, “S.F. lawmakers tackle hunger, PG&E, and SoMa street trees, plus changes to major development plans this week,” 20 September 2026

raw.text: changes to the special use district and development agreement for the Potrero Power Station project, the massive redevelopment of a former PG&E power plant site in Dogpatch into a new mixed-use neighborhood

publish.note: No numbered address: a roundup of agenda items that names projects rather than buildings. The headline would also describe the wrong thing on any page it landed on — it is about a week of legislative business, not about a building.
